title: Case Analyzes for Late Endograft Migration After Tevar Using a Special Software and a Literature Review
content: Post-TEVAR (thoracic endovascular aortic repair) follow-up is essential to monitor adverse aortic remodeling, despite technological advancements in stent grafts regarding their flexibility and durability. This article, along with the study of a clinical case over 10 years, explores the use of 3D morphological analysis and shows how type III endoleaks can drastically alter the morphology of the aorta. The literature review was to report the cumulative incidence of endograft migration as well as the morbidity, reintervention rates, and mortality related to endograft migration, to justify the importance of close standardized surveillance after TEVAR.
